limits: Paz selected here is the adult original GZ prisoner incarnation with short cropped blond hair, pale worn collared/buttoned tunic, sleeves rolled at elbows, bare lower legs/feet. She is not the TPP medical hallucination with braids/blue gown and not PW school-cover outfit.

Dark/orange and night-vision original capture lighting occludes neutral pale shirt hue, reverse seams and some garment hem details. Sprite pale beige-grey-green hue, cloth stain placement, exact buttons/finger topology and feet anatomy remain closest_supported, not exact model/material1:1.

These calm support/defense, authored normals/jump/guard, light recoil/tired-rest KO, empty-hand signal/protection/CQC/composure poses are bonus versus simulation after restraint release, not a canonical recovered GZ duel or an assertion that original trauma never occurred. No wounds, graphic violence, underwear, chains or bomb scenes appear.

B LEFT01 omitted a body and contains11 rather than12 poses; it is rejected, preserved and replaced by independently regenerated B LEFT02 containing12 complete bodies. No pixel erasure/paint/mirroring was used.

Target remains1:1 fidelity to selected original incarnation, closest_supported output only. Newly illustrated2D poses are not extracted original animation; absolute1:1 artistic or gameplay certification is false.

No firearm/grenade/projectile origin, bomb, ZEKE control, armor inheritance, psychic field or summoned machine is invented. Existing action keys shoot/deploy merely identify non-ballistic signal/protection pose groups; root must explicitly supersede historical generic weapon behavior.

Native source PNGs and all attempts unchanged. Both facings independently generated and SHA-distinct, no mirrored body raster. Every selected atlas and each12 complete bodies physically viewed by producer. Canvas crops/contours, source scale, mobile/desktop, phase/hitbox/finisher behavior remain independently root-owned.

Close native row spacing produces recorded foreign opaque pixels in some bounding rectangles. Metadata Canvas contour stencils exclude neighbors; no image pixels edited. Use the measured upright source height for each sheet, retaining actual lowered crouch/KO size.
review.approvalScope: Source-qualified adult original-game clothing/identity and72 authored human unarmed bonus poses, no canon duel or runtime integration certification.
